versions.subject: ADS stored DLL execution using Rundll32
fix: apply suggestions from code review
fix: update regex
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    # Example:
    #   rundll32 "C:\ads\file.txt:ADSDLL.dll",DllMain
    # Note: This doesn't cover the use case where a full path for the DLL isn't used. As it requires a more expensive regex
    CommandLine|re: '[Rr][Uu][Nn][Dd][Ll][Ll]32.+\w:.+:'
condition: selection

versions.subject: fix: sharpen regex to not match default windows rundll32 usage
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    # Example:
    #   rundll32 "C:\ads\file.txt:ADSDLL.dll",DllMain
    # Note: This doesn't cover the use case where a full path for the DLL isn't used. As it requires a more expensive regex
    CommandLine|re: '[Rr][Uu][Nn][Dd][Ll][Ll]32(\.[Ee][Xx][Ee])? \S+?\w:\S+?:'
condition: selection

versions.subject: fix: added originalfilename
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'RUNDLL32.EXE'
selection_cli:
    # Example:
    #   rundll32 "C:\ads\file.txt:ADSDLL.dll",DllMain
    # Note: This doesn't cover the use case where a full path for the DLL isn't used. As it requires a more expensive regex
    CommandLine|re: '[Rr][Uu][Nn][Dd][Ll][Ll]32(\.[Ee][Xx][Ee])? \S+?\w:\S+?:'
condition: all of selection_*
